name: Metagosan
description: The Metagosan were a reptilian sentient species. Possessing dense musculature, they were similar to the Trandoshans. The species had a typical sibilant hiss when speaking. One Metagosan was Vin-Vin Sunfall, the bartender of Vin-Vin's Wheelhouse in the city New Xaxxis on the Outer Rim planet Metagos.
